headline: Executive order from 1994 on reforming how federal agencies buy goods and services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with changing the way federal agencies buy products and services, a process called procurement. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, or requirements it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their purchasing staff
who_it_affects.how: They would be expected to follow any changes the order makes to how the government buys goods and services.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that sell to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: Changes to federal buying practices could affect how these companies compete for and carry out government contracts.
